overview.headline: Calm, Readable Interfaces and Honest Charts — Built Automatically
overview.summary: Quiet User Interface Skills gives developers and AI coding agents a zero-dependency design system, calibrated SVG chart and diagram compilers, clear everyday framing, and automated layout checks.

quickstart_steps.title: 1 — Install Once
quickstart_steps.body: Clone the repository or pull individual skills into Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.

quickstart_steps.title: 2 — Try Live Examples
quickstart_steps.body: Browse 26 interactive workspaces and 53 calibrated building blocks across all 4 color themes.

quickstart_steps.title: 3 — Audit Automatically
quickstart_steps.body: Run offline HTML and Chrome layout checks to catch clipped text, low contrast, or color drift.

install_commands.label: Install Quiet UI Skill via Skills CLI

plain_language_blocks.title: Calm Layouts & Automatic Quality Checks
plain_language_blocks.body: Ship clean pages across phones, tablets, desktops, and printouts in 4 readable themes with accessible forms, helpful empty states, and automated layout checks before merge.

plain_language_blocks.title: Calibrated Charts & System Diagrams
plain_language_blocks.body: Compile clean 1-2-5 scaled plots, waveforms, bitfields, and system diagrams from structured JSON with zero runtime dependencies and visible gaps when readings are missing.

plain_language_blocks.title: Plain-Language Clarity Across Audiences
plain_language_blocks.body: Present the same verified facts clearly across executive summaries, engineering reviews, and hands-on operator guides so numbers, limits, and units always match.

plain_language_blocks.title: 60-Second Brand Setup & Reusable Site Shell
plain_language_blocks.body: Copy an MIT starter kit to swap colors, fonts, and copy in seconds, or spin up this same 3-route overview, demo, and docs hub for any open-source project.
